A_NORMAL_SUCCESS_THEOREM.scope: Inherited composition only: 1<=K<=N<=256; at most one static semi-honest party; ideal FTv3 issuance success/cap_success; ideal F_TOPK output refresh; ideal A token RNG; honest peer causal execution; T/A trusted and non-colluding with corrupted party; exogenous nonselective SuccessFence; one externally specified source-event cut j in S61 E_cut. Not real wall-clock/timeout success conditioning, arbitrary abort-prefix privacy, deployment security, or complete protocol security.

S61_EVENT_CUTS.scope: Only fixed source-event boundaries after successful package validation, preflight/lease and ideal channel setup. Share z_b is withheld before local share formation and available only as that party's staged local state after formation. No partial-byte, TLS-record, arbitrary instruction, or failure cuts.

FTV3_IDEAL_CAP_ABORT_LOCAL_OUTCOME.scope: Ideal IID bounded sampler local outcome: cap exhaustion burns invocation and returns ISSUANCE_ABORT to the issuer; no party package/context or online lease. Does not define same-invocation party delivery/start/notice. S60 conservative semantic-material bound only; not deployment error probability or full transcript distance.

CAP_ABORT_TO_PARTY_DELIVERY_START_NOTICE.first_gap: No current joint kernel maps one invocation's ideal cap-abort to package/context delivery, start_0/start_1, party-visible notice_0/notice_1, and party API state. Fixed runtime has separate issuer and party APIs; TEST_ONLY E2E controller's success-gated launch is not production routing.
CAP_ABORT_TO_PARTY_DELIVERY_START_NOTICE.candidate: CONDITIONAL proof-only F_TOPK-ISSUE-ESCROW/v1 branches NONE_NO_CALL, PAIRED_GENERIC_ABORT, or an explicitly modeled per-party notice kernel; no branch is owner-approved or implemented. PAIRED_GENERIC_ABORT may expose a uniform abort to parties only if the owner confirms that observation is already within the approved L_S29 abort field; otherwise its leakage mapping remains unapproved.

ISSUANCE_ERROR_CLASS_SEPARATION.scope: Source mapping separates sampler cap exhaustion from marker EEXIST replay refusal, signer/key errors, marker I/O, RAND_bytes errors, signing/serialization failures and sequential file publication failures. This classification does not model their party-view probabilities.

ESCROW_ABORT_UNKNOWN_RECOVERY_FAILURE_SI.first_gap: After first valid deposit creates A PENDING, no ideal conditional kernel specifies whether the honest second deposit arrives before A wait expiry, A's hidden state transition, and the corrupted party's actual response-delivery/parse observation.
